name: Sou no Anata, Utsu no Atashi
original_name: 躁のあなた鬱のあたし
source:
When "Utsumi" meets "Utsumi"—
two sides of the same girl begin to blend,
shaping what may become... a "wonderful girl."

Shoutarou Takamine is an ordinary young man with an extraordinary obsession: idols.
Now a working adult, he lives a quiet life with his girlfriend, Utsumi Kumozora—a woman struggling with depression.

But one fateful argument sparked by jealousy leads to a moment that shatters everything.

“If you’re going to leave me, I’ll just die!”

With a knife pressed against her neck, Utsumi makes a desperate plea.
But Shoutarou walks away—and she follows through with her final, tragic promise.

Years later, Shoutarou is working at a talent agency when he meets a cheerful, energetic idol named Utsumi Harusora…
a girl who looks and sounds exactly like his lost love.

Why does she know about Utsumi’s death?
Why did she approach him?
And who… or what… is she, really?

As memories resurface and truths unravel, Shoutarou is forced to face a past he tried to bury—
and the mystery behind the woman who calls herself "Utsumi."

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860040/Manic_you_and_depressed_me/?beta=0]Steam[/url]]
